No force majeure clause was found. Without one, neither party has a defined process for excusing performance during events outside their control (e.g. natural disaster, government order).

evidence_quote: This agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days prior to expiry.
explanation: The auto-renewal clause requires action from the reviewing party well before expiry; missing the 60-day notice window will silently extend the agreement for another year.

evidence_quote: Each party shall indemnify the other against direct losses arising from a breach of this agreement.
explanation: Indemnity is limited to direct losses only; consequential or indirect losses (e.g. lost profits) are not covered, which may be narrower than the reviewing party expects.

evidence_quote: This agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
explanation: Low severity by default, but material if either party expected local jurisdiction to apply -- severity reflects typical risk, not this clause's importance to a given reviewer.
